role: development set (regression check). The separate fresh set is test/eval/library-eval.json; its runs are recorded in test/eval/library-eval-runs.json.
about: Offline evaluation set for the context chat. Measures retrieval and context behaviour only; it says nothing about the quality of real model answers, which remains unverified. Expected passages were chosen by reading the library; a case passes when any expected passage (or, where only sources are listed, any passage from an expected source) is in the top 5. The glossary was tuned while these questions were known, so this is a regression check, not a held-out test.
